nodes.title: Instruction (sheet)
widgets_values: Character turnaround sheet: Maya, a 25-year-old fictional female explorer, premium stylized three-dimensional animated adventure character: short curly auburn hair, warm amber eyes, small freckles across the nose, expressive oval face, friendly confident smile, athletic but natural body proportions, mustard-yellow utility jacket, dark teal adventure backpack, charcoal cargo trousers, tan leather hiking boots. Distinctive recognizable silhouette, high-quality 3D materials, detailed fabric textures, natural facial expressions, beautiful cinematic lighting. Original fictional character, no resemblance to celebrities or existing animated characters, no logos, no typography. Front view, three-quarter view and side view standing next to each other, full body, neutral light grey studio background.

nodes.title: Instruction 1
widgets_values: Use the character from the reference image: keep exactly the same face, hairstyle, clothing colors, backpack and proportions. SCENE: Maya arrives at a beautiful historic railway station at sunrise, carrying a folded adventure map. Premium stylized 3D animated film still, cinematic lighting, portrait orientation.
